# Timeline of Modern Approaches for Fraud Detection in Highly Imbalanced Transaction Datasets

**Question:** Compare modern approaches for detecting fraud in highly imbalanced transaction datasets, including how such models should be evaluated.

## Summary

Deep Learning models such as Convolutional Neural Networks, Recurrent Neural Networks, and Long Short-term Memory architectures have shown strong performance in modeling complex transaction sequences and behavioral patterns. [S3] F1-Score is the harmonic mean of Precision and Recall, providing a single-figure balance of both metrics useful when class distribution is skewed. [S1] False positives can lead to customer dissatisfaction, while false negatives can result in significant financial losses. [S1] AUC-PR is the go-to metric when fraud cases are rare and we care about catching as many as possible without overwhelming the system with false alarms. [S1]

## Limitations

- The evidence does not specify the exact impact of transaction volume spikes on model degradation.
